name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
description: Provides cashless health insurance for eligible low-income families across India.
benefit: Health insurance coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.

name: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
description: Safe motherhood intervention under the National Health Mission encouraging institutional delivery among pregnant women.
benefit: Direct cash assistance up to ₹1,400 for institutional delivery and post-natal care.

name: Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram (JSSK)
description: Free healthcare services for pregnant women and sick newborns in public health institutions.
benefit: Free delivery, medicines, diagnostics, food during hospital stay, and free transport to and from hospital.

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
description: Scholarship for meritorious students from economically weaker sections to arrest drop-out at class VIII.
benefit: Scholarship of ₹12,000 per annum (₹1,000 per month) for secondary school education.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC Students
description: Financial assistance to students belonging to reserved categories for pursuing higher studies.
benefit: Full tuition fee reimbursement and monthly maintenance allowance for diploma, degree, and postgraduate courses.

name: UP Scholarship & Fee Reimbursement Scheme
description: State scholarship for Pre-Matric and Post-Matric students residing in Uttar Pradesh.
benefit: Financial aid and complete course fee reimbursement for school and college students in Uttar Pradesh.

name: National Programme for Health Care of the Elderly (NPHCE)
description: Dedicated healthcare and wellness support system for senior citizens at primary and district levels.
benefit: Free geriatric care, specialized health check-ups, free medicines, and dedicated senior citizen OPD wards.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
description: Monthly pension for senior citizens belonging to below poverty line (BPL) households.
benefit: Monthly pension of ₹500 to ₹1,000 credited directly to beneficiary bank account.

name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
description: Income support scheme for small and marginal landholding farmer families across India.
benefit: Financial benefit of ₹6,000 per year transferred in three equal installments of ₹2,000 directly to bank accounts.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY - Urban & Gramin)
description: Housing assistance scheme to ensure affordable shelter with basic amenities for low income families.
benefit: Interest subsidy up to 6.5% on housing loans or direct construction grant of up to ₹2.5 Lakhs.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY)
description: Skill certification scheme enabling unemployed youth to take up industry-relevant skill training.
benefit: Free short-term skill training, government certification, placement assistance, and stipend.

name: UP Mukhyamantri Yuva Swarozgar Yojana
description: Financial assistance and subsidy for educated unemployed youth of Uttar Pradesh to start their own enterprises.
benefit: Loan up to ₹25 Lakhs for industry sector and ₹10 Lakhs for service sector with up to 25% margin money grant.
